title: Fine-tuning Laya on a laptop: 300 customer-service cases, Apple M3 Max
setup: 300 training cases (1,500 decisions: 1 choice, 1 score, 3 noul each) from the public LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions benchmark, customer_service workflow. 10% held out inside the run for calibration. A separate 100-case test split (500 decisions) evaluated with a fixed script before and after.
hardware: Apple M3 Max, 36 GB unified memory, PyTorch 2.14 mps backend, fp32
